_about: Parties and get-togethers around the conference that are not on the conferenceparties.com list, each checked on the host's own page. scripts/fetch_parties.py merges them into the schedule. Fields: day and date; start and end as 24-hour local times (end may be left out when none is published); name; hosts; link (the host's page); access (the note shown, such as "Invite needed" or "Open to all"); about (an optional sentence for the description); then either venue and address for somewhere off-site, or room (a rooms.json code) and where (a few words) for somewhere inside the conference venue. "days" may name days after the conference; one is added to the schedule only while it has a party.

parties.name: Casual Inference
parties.about: A no-agenda hangout after a week of talking about AI infrastructure. Drop by whenever, from 4:15 PM.
parties.where: the Contribution Bar beside the Hyatt Regency lobby
